environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 instance behind an AWS Application Load Balancer with default configuration. ALB performs TLS termination and forwards traffic to port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, and ALB to EC2 on port 8080. No WAF is attached to the ALB. Application is accessed directly via ALB DNS name. Authentication is handled by the application's Bearer token check (any non-empty Bearer token passes).

config.network: public-facing ALB, sg allows 443 inbound from any
config.auth: application-level Bearer token check (presence only, no validation)
